meta.subject: Iceshrimp.NET Mastodon-compatible API — compatibility gap reference
meta.compared_against: Official Mastodon API method index at https://docs.joinmastodon.org/methods/
meta.purpose: Use this to determine which Mastodon client API features will NOT work against an Iceshrimp.NET server, so a client app can gate or hide the relevant UI/features.
meta.caveat: This reflects one instance's OpenAPI spec at one point in time (beta software, changes frequently). Streaming (WebSocket) endpoints are known to be implemented but are not documented in the REST OpenAPI spec, so they are excluded from this analysis rather than marked missing.

status_legend.not_implemented: No corresponding endpoint exists at all
status_legend.partial: Some but not all endpoints in this feature area exist
status_legend.path_diverges: Feature is implemented but under a non-standard (Pleroma-style or Iceshrimp-specific) path instead of the official Mastodon route
status_legend.supported: Full parity with official Mastodon API for this feature area

categories.name: trends
categories.notes: No trending feed of any kind (tags, statuses, or links).

categories.name: admin
categories.notes: Entire Mastodon admin API surface is absent. Iceshrimp.NET implements its own separate admin/moderation API at /api/iceshrimp/admin/* and /api/iceshrimp/moderation/* with different shapes. A client's admin panel built against the standard Mastodon admin API will not function.

categories.name: followed_tags
categories.notes: Hashtag timelines can be viewed (GET /api/v1/timelines/tag/{hashtag}) but tags cannot be followed/unfollowed as first-class objects.

categories.name: notification_policy_requests
categories.notes: The 'filter notifications from people you don't follow' feature set is entirely absent.

categories.name: proofs
categories.notes: Deprecated in modern Mastodon anyway; low priority.

categories.name: featured_tags
categories.notes: Can view another account's featured tags but cannot manage your own.

categories.name: notifications_dismiss_clear
categories.notes: Read/dismiss functionality exists but under a Pleroma-style path, not the standard Mastodon route.

categories.name: filters_v1
categories.notes: Only /api/v2/filters is implemented. Low priority since v1 filters are deprecated upstream too.

categories.name: reactions_and_quotes
categories.notes: Functionally present but under Pleroma-style paths rather than native Mastodon quote-post routes (e.g. no /api/v1/statuses/{id}/quotes).

categories.name: custom_emoji_duplicate_path
categories.notes: Both paths return emoji; not a gap, just noting the duplicate/non-standard route.

categories.name: bite
categories.notes: Iceshrimp-specific extension (POST /api/v1/bite, /api/v1/users/{id}/bite, /api/v1/bites/{id}/bite_back, /api/v1/statuses/{id}/bite) with no equivalent in official Mastodon API. Purely additive, not a gap.

categories.name: accounts
supported_endpoints: POST follow, unfollow, remove_from_followers, mute, unmute, block, unblock, note

categories.name: statuses
supported_endpoints: context, favourite, unfavourite, reblog, unreblog, pin, unpin, mute, unmute

categories.name: search
categories.notes: v2 search implemented; v1 search absent but deprecated upstream anyway.

categories.name: reports_submit
categories.notes: POST /api/v1/reports only — no admin-side report handling (see admin category).

categories.name: apps_oauth
categories.notes: apps/verify_credentials, POST apps, oauth/token, oauth/revoke present.

categories.name: streaming
categories.notes: WebSocket streaming API is reported elsewhere as implemented but is not documented in this REST-only OpenAPI spec, so its actual endpoint-level completeness could not be verified here.
